My name no matter, but I tell you how I go do this my beans farm. This 0.75 hectare na cowpea I dey plant, and you sabi say beans no really need plenty fertilizer because the crop dey make its own nitrogen for soil. But the insects — especially pod borer and thrips — fit finish the whole farm if I no spray, so pesticide na the main thing wey I must buy this year. I go use the seed wey I keep from last harvest because improved seed dey expensive and the agro-dealer for our area no always get am. My younger brothers go help me with weeding, but for harvest time I go hire small labor because beans dey ripe quick and you must pick am before the pods dry and scatter.
